final: WITH per AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_h FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), ref AS (SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS a FROM per WHERE avg_h IS NOT NULL), kept AS (SELECT p.equipref, p.avg_h FROM per p, ref r WHERE r.a IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_h > r.a), km AS (SELECT AVG(avg_h) AS k FROM kept), res AS (SELECT kept.equipref AS equipref, kept.avg_h AS avg_humidity, kept.avg_h - ref.a AS excess_over_overall, kept.avg_h - km.k AS diff_from_kept_mean FROM kept, ref, km WHERE ref.a IS NOT NULL AND km.k IS NOT NULL), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC) AS rk FROM res) SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, excess_over_overall, diff_from_kept_mean FROM ranked WHERE rk <= 10 ORDER BY diff_from_kept_mean DESC
